steps:
$\mathrm{f}(0)=\operatorname{Lim}_{\mathrm{x} \rightarrow 0} \frac{\mathrm{e}^{\tan \mathrm{x}}-\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{x}}+\ell \mathrm{n}(\sec \mathrm{x}+\tan \mathrm{x})-\mathrm{x}}{\tan \mathrm{x}-\mathrm{x}}$ Applying L'hospital rule
$$\begin{array}{l}
\Rightarrow f(0)=\operatorname{Lim}_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{e^{\tan x} \cdot \sec ^{2} x-e^{x}+\sec x-1}{\sec ^{2} x-1} \\
\Rightarrow f(0)=\operatorname{Lim}_{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{e^{\tan x}\left(\sec ^{2} x-1\right)+\left(e^{\tan x}-e^{x}\right)+\sec x-1}{\tan ^{2} x} \\
\Rightarrow f(0)=\operatorname{Lim}_{x \rightarrow 0}\left(e^{\tan x}+\frac{e^{x}\left(e^{\tan x-x}-1\right)}{\tan ^{2} x}+\frac{1}{\sec x+1}\right) \\
\Rightarrow f(0)=1+0+\frac{1}{2}=\frac{3}{2}
\end{array}$$
